svg.title: Webcam aspect ratio and black bars
svg.desc: Stacked bars comparing how much of a 1920-pixel-wide display a 16:9 and a 4:3 webcam stream fill when shown fullscreen; the 4:3 stream leaves 480 pixels of black bars.
